description: You've been prescribed 4 new medications and need to find the cheapest pharmacy options. Open the text file at /home/ga/Desktop/pharmacy_quotes.txt containing scattered price quotes from 6 pharmacies. Create a structured comparison spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/medication_costs.xlsx that lists all 4 medications (Metformin 500mg, Lisinopril 10mg, Atorvastatin 20mg, Levothyroxine 50mcg) with prices from at least 5 pharmacy options (CVS, Walgreens, Costco, Walmart, GoodRx at Kroger). Calculate total monthly costs for each pharmacy using formulas. The spreadsheet should help identify where to fill each prescription for maximum savings.
